title: fix(spec)!: SqliteConfigSchema.filename refuses '' and a ':'-prefixed name other than ':memory:' at the build and metadata doors
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuV5cRafodM2YQHxeDkdiWJM)_

domain:spec#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkEKsyGSzebnh2wdV (card thread of claim 6663609014)

Fixes #30400

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches no SQLite `filename` value, and `content/docs/**` teaches only `:memory:` and file paths, which stay accepted. The prescription ships in the refusal text, the changeset's FROM → TO and the upgrade-guide entry.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：SQLite / SQLite-WASM 数据源的 `filename` 现在在 spec 里就拒收空串和「以 `:` 开头但不是 `:memory:`」的值（例如 `:memory:/srv/data/parts.db`），代码声明的数据源（`os build` / `defineStack`）和 `PUT /api/v1/meta/datasource/NAME` 都会报错并给出改法。
- 为什么改：这类值哪里都打不开真实文件：原生 sqlite 每条语句失败，sqlite-wasm 写入在重连后全部丢失；之前只有数据源管理界面拦，另外两个入口照样存。
- 风险与回滚：已存在这种配置的代码数据源会在构建时报错（本来就不能用）；回滚即还原 `sqlite.zod.ts` 的 refinement 与服务端文件，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/driver/sqlite.zod.ts`（`sqliteFilenameRefusal`）、`packages/services/service-datasource/src/sqlite-database-filename.ts`（删掉的两段改由 spec 判）、`packages/spec/src/data/driver/sqlite-filename-names-a-database.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/driver/sqlite-filename-names-a-database.test.ts`，预期 44 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`** — `SqliteConfigSchema.filename` and `SqliteWasmConfigSchema.filename` share one builder, `sqliteFilename()`, which adds a refinement after the existing placeholder refusal: `''` and any value that starts with `:` without being exactly `:memory:` get one `custom` issue at `filename` that names the value, says why (a leading `:` is not read as a file, so the datasource would store nothing) and prescribes the fix (`:memory:` for an ephemeral database, or a file path). The default stays `:memory:`; `.describe()` / `.meta()` are unchanged, so no generated artifact moved. The filesystem judgement (a path that can be neither opened nor created) stays in the runtime: the schema cannot touch the file system.
- **Both doors that judge a datasource against the spec alone now refuse it**: the build door (`ObjectStackDefinitionSchema`, which `os build` parses in `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts` and `defineStack` raises as `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID`), and the metadata door (`PUT /api/v1/meta/datasource/NAME`, which judges with the registered `datasource` type schema, `DatasourceSchema`, whose config refinement replays the driver contract and answers `422 INVALID_METADATA`).
- **One definition** — `@objectstack/service-datasource`'s `sqlite-database-filename.ts` loses its own `''` and `:`-prefix arms. `assertValidConfig` already runs the driver-contract parse (`validateDriverConfig`) first and calls the filename judge only when that is clean, so the admin doors now get those two refusals from the spec, word for word as before (`config.filename:` + the same sentence). Its filesystem arm is kept. The function's docblock states the precondition and the ⛔ against restating the arms.
- **ADR-0087** — semantic migration `sqlite-filename-names-no-database-refused` (step 18): no mechanical rewrite, because whether the author meant `:memory:` or the path typed after it is a judgement about the datasource.
- **Changeset** `30400-sqlite-filename-names-a-database.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/service-datasource` minor, BREAKING banner, FROM → TO, disposition `registered sqlite-filename-names-no-database-refused`.

## Verification

Readings on `objectstack-ai/objectstack`. Final head `5c12bcd4` (origin/main merged in): spec `check:generated` 14/14, the new pins 44/44 and `service-datasource` 72/72 files (1195 tests) were re-run there. Steps naming `9e360bb3` were taken on the pre-merge head; the derived-gate re-sweep on the final head is in the os-dev-report.

<details><summary>New pins — 44/44</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/driver/sqlite-filename-names-a-database.test.ts` → `Tests 44 passed (44)`.

Per schema (sqlite, sqlite-wasm): the registry answers this schema for the driver id; six refused values (`:memory:/srv/data/parts.db`, `:memory:parts.db`, `:mem`, `::memory:`, `:`, `''`), each one issue, `code: 'custom'`, `path: ['filename']`, message opening with the value and carrying the prescription, no tracker number; the why sentence; composition with the placeholder refusal (`:${DATA_DIR}/app.db` reports both); the alias table (`path:` is still `unrecognized_keys` pointing at `filename`, and the renamed value meets the refusal); controls `:memory:`, `data/app.db`, `./.objectstack/data/dev.db`, `/var/lib/objectstack/app.db`, `C:\data\app.db`, `file:app.db`, `memory.db` parse unchanged and the absent key still defaults to `:memory:`. Doors: `getMetadataTypeSchema('datasource')` is `DatasourceSchema` and refuses at `config.filename`; `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` refuses at `datasources.0.config.filename`; `defineStack` raises `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422 there; both doors still accept `:memory:` and a file path.

The metadata door's HTTP envelope for a replayed driver-config refusal (`422 INVALID_METADATA` located under `config.`) is pinned live by the existing `packages/qa/dogfood/test/datasource-meta-door-url-credential-trimmed.dogfood.test.ts` (same `DatasourceSchema` → `validateDriverConfig` path, at `config.url`).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation 1 — spec source (pre-merge head 9e360bb3)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/spec/src/data/driver/sqlite.zod.ts --anchor "if (refusal) ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', message: refusal });" --replacement "void refusal; void ctx; …"`: anchor 1 → 0, blob 33624c68 → 0a5f9556. Pin file: `Tests 24 failed | 20 passed (44)` — every refusal, why, composition, renamed-alias and door case red; every control green. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation 2 — spec dist, read by the service door test (one definition)</summary>

Same anchor, replacement carrying `(globalThis as any).ABLATED_30400 = true;`; `OS_SKIP_DTS=1 pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/spec ABLATED_30400` → marker present in 2 built files. `service-datasource` `sqlite-filename-neither-memory-nor-path.test.ts` → exactly the six `:memory:/…` and empty-filename cases red (Test connection and Save, both drivers); the filesystem-arm cases and controls green — the service holds no second copy. Restore leg: blob == HEAD, full spec build, preflight `--absent` → marker absent from all 592 built files, tree clean; the file is 14/14 again.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites</summary>

- `@objectstack/spec` test (pre-merge head): `Test Files 816 passed (816)`, `Tests 25687 passed | 1 todo`; typecheck exit 0; `check:test-typecheck` OK (52 files / 240 errors / 131 pinned signatures held).
- `@objectstack/service-datasource` test: `Test Files 72 passed (72)`, `Tests 1191 passed (1191)`; typecheck exit 0.

Fixture sweep (`git grep` for `filename` set to `''` or a `:`-prefixed value other than `:memory:` outside dist): no SQLite fixture writes one; the only hits are the #30331 door test (which asserts the refusal) and unrelated `filename` keys (email attachments, print, storage).
- `@objectstack/spec check:generated` (after a spec build): 14/14 up to date (the first run's `check:test-typecheck` was a heap exit without diagnostics; re-run with an 8 GB heap, OK).

- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0, `registered sqlite-filename-names-no-database-refused (new here)`.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at 9e360bb3: 84 families. 81 exit 0 on the first sweep; `check:api-surface` and `check:dual-source-exports` answered exit 3 (spec dist removed under them by a parallel consumer build) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (no full build yet) — prerequisites, not verdicts; after a full `turbo run build` all three exit 0. `--ran` → `84 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 84 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.

Dogfood battery: run on the final head; its counts are in the os-dev-report on #30400.

## Acceptance notes

- **The JSON Schema projection does not carry the refusal.** A `superRefine` does not project, so the driver catalog's `configSchema` (`GET /api/v1/datasources/drivers`) still types `filename` as a plain string. A `pattern` would let a JSON-Schema form refuse inline, but it cannot name the value and it changes what the Setup dialog validates (`ui/**`, `domain:ui#5`); left out on purpose.
- **A producer that can emit a now-refused value**: `sqliteFilenameFromUrl` (`packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.ts`) turns `OS_DATABASE_URL=file::memory:?cache=shared` into `:memory:?cache=shared`. That value already opened no file (every layer reads the leading `:` as fileless); it is now refused wherever it is judged against the spec. Not changed here.
- `.changeset/30331-sqlite-filename-neither-memory-nor-path.md` (unreleased) says the build and meta doors judge `filename` "as before"; true when written, superseded by this changeset in the same release. Not edited (another card's changeset).
- Branch is the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-eau1kb`, not `claude/issue-30400-*`; the claim amendment names it.
